[[File:Timmy EP053.png|thumb|250px|Timmy]] '''Timmy''' (Japanese: '''マナブ''' ''Manabu'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP053|The Purr-Fect Hero]]''. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived at Timmy's school for [[Kids Day]], he was the only one who didn't want to play with any of their Pokémon. He explained that he only wanted to play with a {{p|Meowth}}, because it was the Pokémon that saved him from a {{p|Beedrill}}. After being kidnapped by {{TRT}}, Timmy thought that their {{MTR}} was the same one that rescued him before. When [[Jessie]] and [[James]] discovered this, they forced Meowth to act like Timmy's friend. Unfortunately, their plan backfired when he spoke in front of Ash and the others. After leading Timmy to Team Rocket, they engaged Ash in a {{pkmn|battle}}, which was interrupted by a rockslide. Just as a large boulder was about to crush Timmy and Ash, the real Meowth that Timmy befriended rescued them once again. Timmy adopted the Meowth as his own, and told Ash that when he got older, both of them would compete in the [[Pokémon League]]. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |main=Meowth (Team Rocket) |trainer=Team Rocket |pkmn=Meowth |gender=male |type1=Normal |img=Timmy Meowth Team Rocket.png |epnum=EP002 |epname=Pokémon Emergency! |vajp=Inuko Inuyama |vaen=Maddie Blaustein |desc=The only Pokémon Timmy wanted to see on Kids Day was a {{p|Meowth}}. So when {{TRT}} tried to steal {{AP|Pikachu}} again, Timmy was caught instead. After seeing Meowth Timmy calmed down thinking Meowth was the one who saved him, and Team Rocket decided to put on another scheme. [[Jessie]] and [[James]] put on an act to look like they were trying to hurt Timmy. Meowth used Fury Swipes knocking the duo to the ground and Timmy and Meowth ran off. They later arrived back at the school, where all the children started to crowd around Meowth. Suddenly the Scratch Cat Pokémon talks which {{an|Misty}} hears, Meowth runs off followed by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} including Timmy. Meowth arrives back with Team Rocket, after losing the battle, Meowth runs off with Team Rocket. Meowth's only known move that Timmy commanded was {{m|Fury Swipes}}.}} ===Adopted=== {{anchor|Meowth 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Timmy |pkmn=Meowth |type1=Normal |img=Timmy Meowth.png |epnum=EP053 |epname=The Purr-fect Hero |vajp=Kaori Tsuji |vaen=Kaori Tsuji |desc=It first appeared in a flashback where in a forest, Timmy was attacked by a wild {{p|Beedrill}}. {{p|Meowth}} attacked the Beedrill multiple times before it admitted defeat and flew away. Timmy always wanted to see Meowth again, and on Kids Day, Timmy thought {{MTR}} from {{TRT}} was it. It appeared later where a huge boulder fell down from the cliffs by [[Brock's Onix]] using {{m|Tackle}}; everyone was able to get out of the way except for {{Ash}} and Timmy. They were about to get crushed when Meowth appeared cracking the boulder in two. Timmy recognized it as the Meowth that had saved him previously. Meowth's only known move is {{m|Fury Swipes}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=こおろぎさとみ ''[[Satomi Koorogi]]'' |en=[[Kayzie Rogers]] |ar=امال سعد الدين ''Amal Saad Eddin'' |fi=Elise Langenoja |it=Federica Valenti |no=Siri Nilsen |es_la=Ana Lobo |es_eu=Cristina Yuste |pt_br=Diego Marques |pl=Renata Berger|nl=Huub Dikstaal}}
